mechanism_narrative: A high level of real GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates strong economic activity supporting corporate earnings and investor confidence, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days when GDPC1 exceeds the 5-year rolling average.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 exceeds the 5-year rolling average.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, it signals monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in PAYEMS and decrease in UNRATE indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS rising and UNRATE falling does not produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in HOUST signals weakening consumer demand that reduces corporate revenue expectations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, HOUST declines do not consistently produce negative 20-day returns (e.g., when decline magnitude < 1% in prior month).

mechanism_narrative: A rising INDPRO indicates robust manufacturing activity that signals economic expansion and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO rises above the 3-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL year-over-year change exceeds 2.5%, it signals inflationary pressures that prompt Federal Reserve tightening, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in HOUST and RSAFS indicates weakening consumer demand that reduces corporate revenue expectations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST and RSAFS declining does not produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in UNRATE signals labor market strengthening that boosts consumer spending, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the high-unemployment regime, UNRATE declines do not consistently produce positive 20-day returns (e.g., when decline magnitude < 0.2 percentage points).
